coordinateConvention: Zero-based pixel bounds [left, top, rightExclusive, bottomExclusive]. Measured independently from the rendered alpha mask with alpha > 1; use these bounds instead of assuming equal-size cells.

alphaNotes.note: Transparent gaps remain visually empty. All outside-frame residue is alpha=1/255 and was preserved rather than edited.

64pxAssessment: containFit64px records calculated dimensions for each measured frame inside a 64x64 box. Main silhouettes and palette remain distinct; no separate downsampled preview was saved.
source_metadata_scope: Original PNG provenance before Beta repository optimization, not current WebP byte hashes. See assets/optimization-manifest.json for the runtime file mapping and hashes. Original PNGs are retained outside this repository.
